fullText.simplified:
我叫谢鱼儿（上）

    我叫谢鱼儿，是一个秘书。我的老板姓钱，他是一个好老板，也是一个好人。我爱他，但是他不知道。我不想让他知道，因为他爱的人不是我，他爱白秘书。
    三年前我来这个公司上班。我每天早上八点五十到公司，准备好咖啡给老板。他每天九点左右喝一杯咖啡，然后开始工作。记得有一天，我去晚了。老板九点没喝到咖啡，他有点儿不高兴，他问我为什么晚了。我告诉他我家离公司很远，我每天坐公共汽车要花两个小时，今天我起床晚了，对不起。
    老板听完以后，问我有没有吃早饭。他知道我没吃早饭以后，给了我一个面包和一杯牛奶。他说他现在不想吃东西，早饭给我吃。那个时候，我知道自己爱上他了。
    我关心他，我知道很多他的事情。他喜欢穿白色的衣服。他喜欢一个人去电影院看电影。他喜欢吃鸡蛋面，不喜欢吃西瓜。他喜欢坐火车，不喜欢坐飞机。每个星期五他都跟朋友去打篮球，每天早上他都跑步。晴天的时候，他在公司旁边的运动场跑步；下雨的时候，他去健身房跑步。
    我希望我可以和他一起吃饭，一起看电影，一起跑步，但我只是他的秘书。我不能告诉他我爱他，因为我害怕。如果我告诉了他，他会不会让我离开？现在我不告诉他，我还可以跟他一起工作，我不走，不想离开他。
fullText.traditional:
我叫謝魚儿（上）

    我叫謝魚儿，是一個秘書。我的老闆姓錢，他是一個好老闆，也是一個好人。我愛他，但是他不知道。我不想讓他知道，因為他愛的人不是我，他愛白秘書。
    三年前我來這個公司上班。我每天早上八點五十到公司，準備好咖啡給老闆。他每天九點左右喝一杯咖啡，然後開始工作。記得有一天，我去晚了。老闆九點沒喝到咖啡，他有點兒不高興，他問我為什麼晚了。我告訴他我家離公司很遠，我每天坐公共汽車要花兩個小時，今天我起床晚了，對不起。
    老闆聽完以後，問我有沒有吃早飯。他知道我沒吃早飯以後，給了我一個麵包和一杯牛奶。他說他現在不想吃東西，早飯給我吃。那個時候，我知道自己愛上他了。
    我關心他，我知道很多他的事情。他喜歡穿白色的衣服。他喜歡一個人去電影院看電影。他喜歡吃雞蛋麵，不喜歡吃西瓜。他喜歡坐火車，不喜歡坐飛機。每個星期五他都跟朋友去打籃球，每天早上他都跑步。晴天的時候，他在公司旁邊的運動場跑步；下雨的時候，他去健身房跑步。
    我希望我可以和他一起吃飯，一起看電影，一起跑步，但我只是他的秘書。我不能告訴他我愛他，因為我害怕。如果我告訴了他，他會不會讓我離開？現在我不告訴他，我還可以跟他一起工作，我不走，不想離開他。

sentences.simplified: 我叫谢鱼儿，是一个秘书。我的老板姓钱，他是一个好老板，也是一个好人。
sentences.traditional: 我叫謝魚儿，是一個秘書。我的老闆姓錢，他是一個好老闆，也是一個好人。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jiào xiè yú ér shì yí ge mì shū wǒ de lǎo bǎn xìng qián tā shì yí ge hǎo lǎo bǎn yě shì yí ge hǎo rén
sentences.english: My name is Xie Yu’er, and I am a secretary. My boss’s surname is Qian. He is a good boss and a good man.

sentences.simplified: 我爱他，但是他不知道。
sentences.traditional: 我愛他，但是他不知道。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ ài tā dàn shì tā bù zhī dào
sentences.english: I love him, but he doesn’t know that.

sentences.simplified: 我不想让他知道，因为他爱的人不是我，他爱白秘书。
sentences.traditional: 我不想讓他知道，因為他愛的人不是我，他愛白秘書。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng ràng tā zhī dào yīn wèi tā ài de rén bú shì wǒ tā ài bái mì shū
sentences.english: I don’t want him to know because the person he loves is not me. He loves Secretary Bai.

sentences.simplified: 三年前我来这个公司上班。
sentences.traditional: 三年前我來這個公司上班。
sentences.pinyin: sān nián qián wǒ lái zhè ge gōng sī shàng bān
sentences.english: Three years ago I came to work at this company.

sentences.simplified: 我每天早上八点五十到公司，准备好咖啡给老板。
sentences.traditional: 我每天早上八點五十到公司，準備好咖啡給老闆。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang bā diǎn wǔ shí dào gōng sī zhǔn bèi hǎo kā fēi gěi lǎo bǎn
sentences.english: Every morning I would get to the office at 8:50 and prepare coffee for my boss.

sentences.simplified: 他每天九点左右喝一杯咖啡，然后开始工作。
sentences.traditional: 他每天九點左右喝一杯咖啡，然後開始工作。
sentences.pinyin: tā měi tiān jiǔ diǎn zuǒ yòu hē yì bēi kā fēi rán hòu kāi shǐ gōng zuò
sentences.english: Every day he would drink a cup of coffee at around 9:00 and then begin working.

sentences.simplified: 记得有一天，我去晚了。
sentences.traditional: 記得有一天，我去晚了。
sentences.pinyin: jì de yǒu yì tiān wǒ qù wǎn le
sentences.english: I remember there was one day I got there late.

sentences.simplified: 老板九点没喝到咖啡，他有点儿不高兴，他问我为什么晚了。
sentences.traditional: 老闆九點沒喝到咖啡，他有點兒不高興，他問我為什麼晚了。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn jiǔ diǎn méi hē dào kā fēi tā yǒu diǎn'r bù gāo xìng tā wèn wǒ wèi shén me wǎn le
sentences.english: The boss didn’t get to drink his coffee at 9:00, so he was a little upset and asked me why I was late.

sentences.simplified: 我告诉他我家离公司很远，我每天坐公共汽车要花两个小时，
sentences.traditional: 我告訴他我家離公司很遠，我每天坐公共汽車要花兩個小時，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ gào su tā wǒ jiā lí gōng sī hěn yuǎn wǒ měi tiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē yào huā liǎng ge xiǎo shí
sentences.english: I told him that my home was very far from the office, so every day I had to take a bus for two hours.

sentences.simplified: 今天我起床晚了，对不起。
sentences.traditional: 今天我起床晚了，對不起。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ qǐ chuáng wǎn le duì bu qǐ
sentences.english: That day I woke up late, and I was sorry.

sentences.simplified: 老板听完以后，问我有没有吃早饭。
sentences.traditional: 老闆聽完以後，問我有沒有吃早飯。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn tīng wán yǐ hòu wèn wǒ yǒu méi yǒu chī zǎo fàn
sentences.english: After hearing this, my boss asked me if I had had breakfast.

sentences.simplified: 他知道我没吃早饭以后，给了我一个面包和一杯牛奶。
sentences.traditional: 他知道我沒吃早飯以後，給了我一個麵包和一杯牛奶。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào wǒ méi chī zǎo fàn yǐ hòu gěi le wǒ yí ge miàn bāo hé yì bēi niú nǎi
sentences.english: When he found out that I hadn’t eaten breakfast, he gave me bread and a glass of milk.

sentences.simplified: 他说他现在不想吃东西，早饭给我吃。
sentences.traditional: 他說他現在不想吃東西，早飯給我吃。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō tā xiàn zài bù xiǎng chī dōng xi zǎo fàn gěi wǒ chī
sentences.english: He said he didn’t want to eat right then and gave me his breakfast.

sentences.simplified: 那个时候，我知道自己爱上他了。
sentences.traditional: 那個時候，我知道自己愛上他了。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge shí hou wǒ zhī dào zì jǐ ài shàng tā le
sentences.english: At that moment, I knew I had fallen in love with him.

sentences.simplified: 我关心他，我知道很多他的事情。
sentences.traditional: 我關心他，我知道很多他的事情。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ guān xīn tā wǒ zhī dào hěn duō tā de shì qing
sentences.english: I care about him, and I know a lot about him.

sentences.simplified: 他喜欢穿白色的衣服。他喜欢一个人去电影院看电影。
sentences.traditional: 他喜歡穿白色的衣服。他喜歡一個人去電影院看電影。
sentences.pinyin: tā xǐ huan chuān bái sè de yī fu tā xǐ huan yí ge rén qù diàn yǐng yuàn kàn diàn yǐng
sentences.english: He likes to wear white clothing. He likes to go to the movie theater and watch movies by himself.

sentences.simplified: 他喜欢吃鸡蛋面，不喜欢吃西瓜。
sentences.traditional: 他喜歡吃雞蛋麵，不喜歡吃西瓜。
sentences.pinyin: tā xǐ huan chī jī dàn miàn bù xǐ huan chī xī guā
sentences.english: He likes to eat egg noodles and doesn’t like to eat watermelon.

sentences.simplified: 他喜欢坐火车，不喜欢坐飞机。
sentences.traditional: 他喜歡坐火車，不喜歡坐飛機。
sentences.pinyin: tā xǐ huan zuò huǒ chē bù xǐ huan zuò fēi jī
sentences.english: He likes to travel by train and doesn’t; like to travel by plane.

sentences.simplified: 每个星期五他都跟朋友去打篮球，每天早上他都跑步。
sentences.traditional: 每個星期五他都跟朋友去打籃球，每天早上他都跑步。
sentences.pinyin: měi ge xīng qī wǔ tā dōu gēn péng you qù dǎ lán qiú měi tiān zǎo shang tā dōu pǎo bù
sentences.english: Every Friday he goes and plays basketball with friends, and every morning he goes for a run.

sentences.simplified: 晴天的时候，他在公司旁边的运动场跑步；下雨的时候，他去健身房跑步。
sentences.traditional: 晴天的時候，他在公司旁邊的運動場跑步；下雨的時候，他去健身房跑步。

sentences.english: When it is sunny, he runs at the sports field next to the office. When it rains, he runs at the gym.

sentences.simplified: 我希望我可以和他一起吃饭，一起看电影，一起跑步，但我只是他的秘书。
sentences.traditional: 我希望我可以和他一起吃飯，一起看電影，一起跑步，但我只是他的秘書。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xī wàng wǒ kě yǐ hé tā yì qǐ chī fàn yì qǐ kàn diàn yǐng yì qǐ pǎo bù dàn wǒ zhǐ shì tā de mì shū
sentences.english: I wish I could eat with him, watch movies with him, and go running with him, but I am just his secretary.

sentences.simplified: 我不能告诉他我爱他，因为我害怕。如果我告诉了他，他会不会让我离开？
sentences.traditional: 我不能告訴他我愛他，因為我害怕。如果我告訴了他，他會不會讓我離開？

sentences.english: I can’t tell him that I love him because I am afraid. If I tell him, would he make me leave?

sentences.simplified: 现在我不告诉他，我还可以跟他一起工作，我不走，不想离开他。
sentences.traditional: 現在我不告訴他，我還可以跟他一起工作，我不走，不想離開他。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ bú gào su tā wǒ hái kě yǐ gēn tā yì qǐ gōng zuò wǒ bù zǒu bù xiǎng lí kāi tā
sentences.english: Right now, since I haven’t told him, I can still work with him. I’m not going to leave. I don’t want to leave him.

sentence_translations: My Name Is Xie Yu’er (1)
My name is Xie Yu’er, and I am a secretary. My boss’s surname is Qian. He is a good boss and a good man.
I love him, but he doesn’t know that.
I don’t want him to know because the person he loves is not me. He loves Secretary Bai.
Three years ago I came to work at this company.
Every morning I would get to the office at 8:50 and prepare coffee for my boss.
Every day he would drink a cup of coffee at around 9:00 and then begin working.
I remember there was one day I got there late.
The boss didn’t get to drink his coffee at 9:00, so he was a little upset and asked me why I was late.
I told him that my home was very far from the office, so every day I had to take a bus for two hours.
That day I woke up late, and I was sorry.
After hearing this, my boss asked me if I had had breakfast.
When he found out that I hadn’t eaten breakfast, he gave me bread and a glass of milk.
He said he didn’t want to eat right then and gave me his breakfast.
At that moment, I knew I had fallen in love with him.
I care about him, and I know a lot about him.
He likes to wear white clothing. He likes to go to the movie theater and watch movies by himself.
He likes to eat egg noodles and doesn’t like to eat watermelon.
He likes to travel by train and doesn’t; like to travel by plane.
Every Friday he goes and plays basketball with friends, and every morning he goes for a run.
When it is sunny, he runs at the sports field next to the office. When it rains, he runs at the gym.
I wish I could eat with him, watch movies with him, and go running with him, but I am just his secretary.
I can’t tell him that I love him because I am afraid. If I tell him, would he make me leave?
Right now, since I haven’t told him, I can still work with him. I’m not going to leave. I don’t want to leave him.
